faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (Banaras Hindu University) Varanasi, commonly known as IIT (BHU), for a project-based research position in Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT (BHU)?
faq.answer: IIT (BHU) has advertised for the post of Lab Attendant (Semi-skilled Manpower) under a MoRT&H-funded project in the Department of Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Lab Attendant position in this project-based recruitment notification released by IIT (BHU) Varanasi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for IIT (BHU) Lab Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to send their applications on plain paper with required documents via post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the offline application form is 19-10-2026. Applications must reach the specified postal address well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Lab Attendant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 12th pass with good health and physical fitness. A desirable qualification includes holding an ITI certificate in relevant trades.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on the date of advertisement. Age relaxation is applicable as per the Government of India norms for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What salary will be provided to the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Lab Attendant position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 20000/- per month as per project norms.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT (BHU) Lab Attendant?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Lab Attendant position involves an Interview where eligible candidates are evaluated based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application should be sent to Dr. Bala Ramudu Paramkusam (PI), Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, IIT (BHU), Varanasi, India 221005 within 21 days of advertisement.
